name: install-bootstrap
description: Reliable source setup and Copilot initialization

spec.why: Make cloned source setup work from the repository root, install current merged code, and verify per-machine Copilot hook materialization.

requirements.text: Root scripts-enabled frozen install and explicit setup delegate dependency installation and build to the existing nested workspace.
Keep runtime workspace and deploy authority under treadle; retire root file dependencies and bundle metadata; preserve a usable local compiled CLI entry.
Use pinned pnpm 9.15.9 through Corepack or a checked fallback, support native source paths with spaces, and propagate failures without later operations.
Both source installers default to main and reuse shared setup, retaining ref overrides, branch protection, global link scope and actual failure exits.
Copilot full project init and hooks-only cold-clone recovery materialize complete hooks without target dependency installation or weakening preservation guards.
Document source setup versus project init, verify actual delivery and wiki health, obtain independent review, and prepare the PR handoff.

out_of_scope: Silent branch migration of existing source installations

decisions.decision: Replace root file-package orchestration with a private source setup wrapper, matching root lockfile, shared nested setup and compiled local bin entry.
decisions.because: Clean probes confirm the boundary defect. Retain the one active workspace and portable deploy mechanism rather than relocating them. Retire unsupported future root bundle metadata. Reversible files.

decisions.decision: Default both source installers to main and reuse pinned shared setup with prerequisite checks, explicit ref overrides and branch mismatch refusal.
decisions.because: Merged code is the current source; one mechanism avoids shell drift. Existing other-branch checkouts remain protected rather than silently switched. Reversible script change.

decisions.decision: Retain generated per-machine hook scripts and runtime pointer; prove and explain full project init and hooks-only cold-clone recovery.
decisions.because: Clones retain portable host definitions but cannot inherit executable paths from another machine. Current manifest already provides local materialization. Preserve existing foreign-file and backup rules.

designs.title: Root source setup interface
designs.detail: Private root manifest/lock and Node setup helper retain the nested workspace and compiled entry.

designs.title: Pinned shared installer bootstrap
designs.detail: Shared helper, native process invocation and main defaults preserve branch and exit guards.

designs.title: Cold-clone Copilot initialization
designs.detail: Use manifest-owned payloads and pointer without target package install; preserve config/guide bytes and explain next steps.

designs.title: Real lifecycle and delivery verification
designs.detail: Real clean root install/build, lock hash comparison, packaging, six gates, wiki health and independent review.

design.approach: Thin root setup wrapper and one pinned source bootstrap; explicit per-machine project init with cold-clone regression coverage.

tasks.title: Repair root source installation and setup entry
tasks.detail: Implement root manifest/lock, shared pinned helper and local compiled bin. Test resolution, lifecycle delegation, native argument paths, failure exits and missing assets. Author real delivery verifier; do not claim its unrun results.

verify.expect: Root frozen resolution, setup order/version, paths with spaces, failed install/build and entry behavior pass.
